newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Fok suspends shares, statement soon.
newsitem.headline: Hong Fok suspends shares, statement soon.

text.p: Property group Hong Fok Corp Ltd said on Friday it had requested a suspension of trading in its shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore pending an announcement expected later in the day.
"The announcement is expected today. I am not in a position to answer any more questions," a Hong Fok spokeswoman said after confirming the suspension request.
Hong Fok shares stood at Singapore $2.87 at the close of business on May 15.

Dealers speculated that the announcement could be related to shareholdings in the company held by associated businesses, the revaluation of some of its property portfolio, or the sale of property in Hong Kong.
"It could be any one of these three," a dealer at a local institution said.
Associated firm Hong Kong-based Winfoong Holdings Ltd, increased its stake in Hong Fok to 8.22 percent in April.
Another related firm, Sui Chong Holdings Ltd, was the subject of a planned sale by Hong Fok and Winfoong which between them have a 74.5 percent stake in the company.
